text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it really feels so refreshing.
...Thank you once again for inviting me out for golf.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, thank YOU! Who would've thought the golf pair ticket
I won in the lottery would expire today...
I'm so glad it didn't go to waste.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I was surprised by how skilled you were.
The way you swung your arms had so much power behind it."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Thanks to you, Trainer, I feel like my body is getting stronger...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Adding more uphill training routines,
increasing the intensity of weight training...
We're trying out some hardcore training, after all.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Still, fatigue doesn't really build up.
They always keep an eye on how I'm doing
...and take good care of me, always.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, is something the matter?
Did I say something strange...?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: No. ...It's just that Still-chan has such a gentle look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I bet she really
adores you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I l-lov... No, that's not...!
I-I just...—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um... let's play golf instead.
It's my turn now, right...!"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! T-That way's the pond!?
Still-chan, come baaack~!
